statements.statement: The patient presents with persistent palpitations and symptomatic bradycardia consistent with a history of sick sinus syndrome.
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is indicated.
The service is supported by diagnoses I49.5 and R00.2.
The denial reason code is PR-204.
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan.
